purpose: Monster Lab round 2: the four directions both judges ranked highest in round 1 (H folded giant, C lamp, G fixtures, E dub), each shown close by eye and at mid range on the camcorder, with the judges' round 1 notes folded in. Letters are internal.
common: Edit this video-game screenshot. Keep the room, the camera, the framing, the lens, the light, the colours, the film grain and any camcorder overlay exactly as they are, and add one creature into the scene as described below. The creature must look physically present: lit by the room's own light, with real shading, volume, surface detail and weight, casting shadows and touching the surfaces it rests on. Photoreal, like a frame from a high-end horror game, not a painting, not a cartoon. No text added, no logos, no gore, no blood. Fully original; it must not resemble any existing film, game or internet creature.

H1.prompt: Very close, about two and a half metres away, an enormous pale figure is folded into the corridor so tightly that it fills it wall to wall: it is crawling toward the camera on its hands and knees, its huge shoulders scraping both walls and pressing up the ceiling tiles, its head bent sideways and resting flat against the ceiling, eyes closed, face calm and slack. Its skin is smooth, dry, grey-beige and slightly waxy like an old mannequin, with faint seams. One huge hand is flat on the carpet in the foreground, fingers too long, the nails grey. The wallpaper is torn where its shoulder has dragged along it.

H2.prompt: In the dim hall about eight metres away, between two columns, an enormous pale figure crawls on its hands and knees, so big that its back nearly touches the ceiling, its head turned sideways and tilted toward the camera, eyes closed. Its smooth grey-beige waxy skin catches the faint light. It is caught mid-movement, one long arm reaching forward on the carpet.

C1.prompt: The ceiling panel just above the camera is dead and a ceiling tile is missing. Hanging head-down out of the hole, about two and a half metres away and filling the upper part of the frame, is a very thin, pale, hairless, elongated creature with translucent waxy skin. A lit fluorescent tube runs inside its body along its spine and narrow ribcage, glowing cold white through the skin and lighting the corridor below it with harsh flickering light and long shadows. Its long arms reach down, fingertips touching the carpet. Its upside-down face is turned toward the camera, eyeless, the mouth a thin closed line.

C2.prompt: About eight metres away in the dim hall, a very thin pale elongated creature crawls along the ceiling upside down like a spider, between the ceiling panels, its long limbs gripping the ceiling grid. A fluorescent tube glows cold white inside its translucent body, the only strong light in that part of the hall, throwing hard light and long moving shadows of the columns across the carpet below it.

G1.prompt: About three metres away a creature made of the ceiling has come down into the corridor: two old fluorescent light troffers joined into a body hanging just under the ceiling, a torn tangle of aluminium ceiling-grid rails and thick grey electrical cables forming six long jointed legs that reach down and plant on the carpet and against both walls like a huge spider. One tube in it is lit and flickering, buzzing, its harsh cold light falling straight down; the other tubes are dark and broken. Several ceiling tiles behind it are missing, wires hanging from the holes. It is big and heavy, filling the corridor.

G2.prompt: About eight metres away in the dim hall, something is moving across the ceiling between the columns: a cluster of torn-out fluorescent light troffers and ceiling-grid rails with long hanging electrical cables for legs, walking upside down along the ceiling grid like a spider. One tube in it is lit, a hard cold light that moves with it and throws swinging shadows of the columns across the carpet; the ceiling tiles along its path are knocked out.

E1.prompt: About three metres away a man in plain grey 1990s office clothes stands perfectly still, facing the camera, arms slightly too long hanging at his sides. Behind him, in exact single file down the corridor, stand more copies of the same man, identical, in step, each a little further away, each copy a little more degraded than the one in front: softer, grainier, slightly smeared sideways like a bad video dub, the furthest ones dissolving into noise. All their faces are smooth and smeared like a paused tape, with no readable features. They are solid and lit by the corridor lights and cast shadows.

E2.prompt: About eight metres away in the dim hall, a line of identical men in plain grey office clothes stands in exact single file between the columns, facing the camera, perfectly still, each one behind the other more degraded and grainier, the last ones dissolving into the dark. Their faces are smooth and smeared like a paused tape.
